text:
anya: Heads-up — ZephyrLite ingestion stuck on onboarding. Legal flagged license terms and perf team saw a latency regression in the 8k token recipe. Who owns final signoff?

devin: I can take runtime ownership for the initial rollout. CR 4329 is open but blocked on the licensing artifact from @legal.

legal: Hi — we reviewed the model license and there are two issues: (1) tokenizer bundle references GPL utilities, (2) attribution text missing. I attached comments to the intake PDF: https://redwood.share/s/zephyr-license.pdf :paperclip: 

sam (perf): Perf summary: tested on stable-rt 2.1, 8k seq, batch=1. 95th p95 increased from 120ms -> 138ms (~+15%). Embedding shape looks fine. S3 perf report: s3://redwood-test/zephyrlite/perf-2026-03-15.html

anya: thanks. Can we get an action list + owners? We'll need that before catalog publish.

devin: I'll enumerate:
1) legal fixes license text — legal
2) tokenizer vendor change or repackage — devinfra
3) re-run perf with quant Q4_8 — sam
4) attach PDF and CR to catalog intake — devin
5) final UAT canary window — ops

I've opened a tiny PR for the catalog manifest: https://git.redwood/inventory/pull/789

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: GPU CI ✅, infra tests failing on driver mismatch — tagging @devinfra

devinfra: driver mismatch is due to CUDA 12 vs 11 on the canary node. We'll patch the image before canary. ETA today EOD.

legal: Uploaded revised license PDF with proper attribution and removed GPL reference. See comment thread on intake.

sam (perf): Re-run queued with Q4_8 and same infra. Preliminary: p95 now ~125ms. I'll post final after run completes.

anya: sweet. Devin can you attach the final perf and legal pdf to the intake and un-block CR? If all green, we'll aim to publish catalog entry on Thursday.

devin: will do. I'll update thread when done. :white_check_mark:

anya: thanks all — ping me if timeline slips.

devin: quick note — command I used to run the perf job for reproducibility:
```bash
./tools/run_perf.sh --model zephyrlite --seq 8192 --quant Q4_8 --out s3://redwood-test/zephyrlite/perf-2026-03-15.html
```

infra-bot: noted. tagging @ops for canary window scheduling.
